statement: No read of a status, role, raft_role, workflow_step, phase or step field carries a || or ?? default: each of the 159 sites either reads a value the schema or constructor already guarantees (the services status column is NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active') or routes the absent case to a named state (R07) at the one owner or decoder that defines it; once the count is zero the pattern is an ESLint no-restricted-syntax selector in eslint.config.js and the guideline audit drops it.

constraints.statement: An absent or unknown state value becomes a named outcome the consumer handles; it never becomes the most common value by default.
Deleting a default without adding a named state cites the column constraint or constructor validation that makes the value present on every path.
The no-restricted-syntax selector lands in the same change as the last deletion, never earlier: a single-file linter rule with existing hits blocks everything or nothing.
The src/ changes land only behind an approving verification newer than the last attempt.
